skill.summary: Use when an agent needs live DeFi data from Base — ETH prices, trending pools, token scores, or wallet scans. No auth required.

latestVersion.changelog: Added 5 DeFi LP farming endpoints for  token pool: /defi/lp/stats (TVL, APY), /defi/lp/position (user holdings), /defi/lp/deposit, /defi/lp/withdraw, /defi/lp/claim-rewards. Read endpoints /bin/bash.01, write endpoints /bin/bash.02 via x402 on Base.
